NOTIFICATION FOR
JOINT DAKSHANA SELECTION TEST (JDST) 2027
The JDST 2027 is scheduled to be held in the month of December 2026 (Tentative).
Selection Process for the JDST 2027: For Students studying in Govt./Aided/Public schools (Not for JNV/EMRS students)
Step 1: Check the eligibility at apply.scholarship.dakshana.org and fill out the application form.
Step 2: Shortlisting will be done based on the cutoff mentioned in the application form.
Step 3: After 1st round of shortlisting, Fill out the Dakshana Scholar Application (DSA).
Step 4: Invited students after filling out the Application form can appear for mock Tests. Mock tests will familiarise students with the interface.
Step 5: Invited students will have to take the test online at the assigned exam center.
Step 6: After the 2nd round of shortlisting (based on JDST 2027), candidates must appear for the interview and document verification.
Step 7: Students selected after the interview will be offered Dakshana One-year Scholarship (Free JEE/NEET coaching, food, and accommodation) at Pune.
*Eligibility: Must meet all the 3 criteria to apply for the scholarship.
i. School: Currently studying in Class 12 Science at a Govt/Aided/Public school (Academic Year 2026-27). Students should have appeared in their
class XII board exam by May 2027.
ii. Merit: Aggregate marks of Maths & Science in Class 10 should be above the cut-off:
For Engineering (Male): GEN: 85%, EWS/OBC: 80%, SC: 70%, ST: 65%, PwD: 55%
For Engineering (Female): GEN: 80%, EWS/OBC: 75%, SC: 65%, ST: 60%, PwD: 50%
For Medical: GEN: 80%, EWS/OBC: 75%, SC: 65%, ST: 60%, PwD: 50%
iii. Annual Family Income: Male – Up to ₹3,00,000 per annum; Female – Up to ₹5,00,000 per annum.
Selection Process for the JDST 2027: For JNV & EMRS school students
Step 1: Students will be invited for the JDST 2027 based on Class 12 Term 1 results.
Step 2: Invited students to fill out Dakshana Scholar Application (DSA).
Step 3: Invited students after filling out the Application form can appear for mock Tests. Mock tests will familiarise students with the interface.
Step 4: Invited students will have to take the test at the assigned exam center.
Step 5: After the 2nd round of shortlisting (based on JDST 2027), candidates must appear for the interview and document verification.
Step 6: Students selected after the interview will be offered Dakshana One-year Scholarship (Free JEE/NEET coaching, food, and accommodation) at Pune.

Filling of Scholar application form:
To appear for the Mock test & JDST 2027, invited students must fill out and submit the scholar application form at http://scholarship.dakshana.org/. Read
the instruction document before filling out the form.
Mock Test & JDST 2027 Format:
The test consists of Multiple Choice Questions. There are a total of 25 questions each in Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics, and Logical Reasoning, and 50
questions in Biology.
Section 1: Physics | Section 2: Chemistry | Section 3: Mathematics/Biology | Section 4: Logical Reasoning
5 marks will be awarded for each correct response, 2 marks will be deducted for each incorrect response and 0 mark will be awarded for unattempted
questions. Engineering Aspirants to attempt Mathematics and Medical aspirants to attempt Biology.
